# Curated resources

Free official material first. Paid courses only where your organization already has a licence.

| Resource | Type | Cost | Best for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Learn Angular in your browser](https://angular.dev/tutorials/learn-angular) | Interactive tutorial | Free | First contact, no setup |
| [Angular Essentials](https://angular.dev/essentials) | Reading | Free | A fast tour of every core concept |
| [Angular Playground](https://angular.dev/playground) | Online sandbox | Free | Trying a snippet without a project |
| [Angular v22 release event](https://angular.dev/events/v22) | Video | Free | What changed in v22 |
| [Angular on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/angular) | Video channel | Free | Official talks and feature deep dives |
| [Angular – The Complete Guide (Maximilian Schwarzmüller, Udemy)](https://www.udemy.com/course/the-complete-guide-to-angular-2/) | Video course | Paid | Foundations track, end to end |
| [Angular Signals (Deborah Kurata, Pluralsight)](https://www.pluralsight.com/library/courses/angular-signals) | Video course | Paid | Week 2 signals deep dive |
| [Angular: RxJS for Reactive Programming (Deborah Kurata, Pluralsight)](https://www.pluralsight.com/courses/angular-rxjs-reactive-programming) | Video course | Paid | Week 4 RxJS |
| [Angular Signals In Depth (Angular 22, Udemy)](https://www.udemy.com/course/angular-signals/) | Video course | Paid | Accelerated track signal patterns |
| [Signal Forms overview](https://angular.dev/guide/forms/signals/overview) | Reading | Free | Choosing and using Signal Forms |
| [httpResource guide](https://angular.dev/guide/http/http-resource) | Reading | Free | Signal-based data fetching |
| [Tailwind CSS with Angular](https://angular.dev/guide/tailwind) | Reading | Free | Theming setup |
| [ngx-translate](https://ngx-translate.org) | Library docs | Free | Runtime translations |
| [TypeScript Handbook](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/handbook/intro.html) | Reading | Free | Week 1 for anyone new to TypeScript |
| [DummyJSON](https://dummyjson.com) | Mock REST API | Free | The API behind Karkhana |
| [Angular Community Discord](https://discord.gg/angular) | Community | Free | Questions the team channel cannot answer |

Prefer videos from 2024 or later; older ones teach NgModules, `*ngIf` and decorator inputs.
